stories.title: Arabie saoudite : flammes et fumée noire visibles près de l'aéroport de Ryad

en.title: Saudi Arabia: flames and black smoke visible near Riyadh airport
en.summary: Flames and black smoke appeared near Riyadh airport on September 19 following explosions during the night, marking the first incident since hostilities with Yemeni Houthis resumed. Analysts describe this as a significant escalation.

stories.title: «Théâtre antifasciste», «exercice de victimisation» : après la suppression de l’édito de Charles Sapin sur France Inter, la gauche exulte, la droite dénonce une atteinte au pluralisme

en.title: "Antifascist theater", "victimization exercise": after the removal of Charles Sapin's editorial from France Inter, the left celebrates, the right denounces an attack on pluralism
en.summary: The removal of Charles Sapin's editorial from France Inter sparked opposing reactions, with right-wing figures criticizing misuse of taxpayer funds while left-wing officials hailed it as a victory for radio staff following mobilization.

stories.title: Des "perturbations majeures" ont affecté l'aéroport de Riyad, après des explosions entendues dans la capitale de l'Arabie saoudite

en.title: "Major disruptions" affected Riyadh airport following explosions heard in Saudi Arabia's capital
en.summary: Riyadh airport experienced major disruptions after explosions were heard in the capital during the night, prompting Saudi Arabia to issue attack warnings for the first time since renewing hostilities with Yemeni Houthis.

stories.title: Éviction de Charles Sapin : pourquoi France Inter a cédé aux syndicats

en.title: Removal of Charles Sapin: why France Inter gave in to unions
en.summary: Charles Sapin was offered participation in a debate instead of an editorial slot, which he declined. He criticized France Inter's management for capitulating to union pressure.

stories.title: Des flammes et de la fumée noire visibles près de l'aéroport de Ryad, de nombreux vols annulés ou retardés

en.title: Flames and black smoke visible near Riyadh airport, many flights cancelled or delayed
en.summary: Riyadh residents were awakened by an attack warning and two strong explosions in the early hours of Sunday, marking the first such incident in the Saudi capital since renewed clashes with Yemeni Houthis.

stories.title: Après un mois de crise, la chronique de Charles Sapin sur France Inter enterrée

en.title: After a month of crisis, Charles Sapin's column on France Inter cancelled
en.summary: Charles Sapin's weekly editorial on the public radio station France Inter is being removed following refusal to transform it into a debate format, after internal sources confirmed his exit from the schedule.

stories.title: France Inter supprime l'édito contesté de Charles Sapin qui déplore "une censure préventive"

en.title: France Inter removes Charles Sapin's contested editorial, which he describes as "preventive censorship"
en.summary: Charles Sapin, a journalist and deputy director of the conservative magazine Valeurs actuelles, announced the cancellation of his weekly editorial on France Inter following protests and strikes over his publication's alleged far-right ideology.

stories.title: Arabie saoudite : des flammes visibles près de l'aéroport de Riyad après de fortes explosions

en.title: Saudi Arabia: flames visible near Riyadh airport after strong explosions
en.summary: Riyadh residents experienced attack warnings and two powerful explosions early Sunday, the first such incident since clashes with Yemeni Houthis resumed, with a fuel tank near the airport belonging to Saudi oil giant Aramco catching fire.

stories.title: Charles Sapin renonce à intervenir sur France Inter après la suppression de son édito du dimanche matin par la direction de la radio publique

en.title: Charles Sapin declines to appear on France Inter after removal of his Sunday morning editorial by public radio management
en.summary: Charles Sapin, deputy director of Valeurs actuelles, declined further participation at France Inter after the station's management cancelled his regular editorial segment and proposed a debate format instead.

stories.title: Guerre au Moyen-Orient : des fortes explosions entendues à Ryad après une alerte aérienne

en.title: Middle East war: loud explosions heard in Riyadh after air alert
en.summary: Saudi Arabia experienced strong explosions in Riyadh following an air raid alert, as the country faces ongoing attacks from pro-Iranian Houthi forces based in Yemen.

stories.title: Budget : la dette publique de la France devrait atteindre un record de 121,7 % du PIB en 2027, selon Bercy

en.title: Budget: France's public debt expected to reach record 121.7% of GDP in 2027, according to Bercy
en.summary: France's Finance Ministry projected public debt will reach 121.7 percent of GDP by 2027, attributing the increase to sustained high budget deficits.

stories.title: Arabie saoudite : explosions et fumée près de l’aéroport de Riyad après une alerte aérienne

en.title: Saudi Arabia: explosions and smoke near Riyadh airport after air alert
en.summary: Riyadh experienced powerful explosions and smoke near its airport following an air raid alert on Saturday, marking the first time the Saudi capital has been targeted during the ongoing Houthi attacks.

stories.title: Un premier F-35 pour la Luftwaffe

en.title: Germany receives first F-35 fighter jet
en.summary: Germany has received its first fifth-generation fighter aircraft, an F-35A manufactured by Lockheed Martin, adding a new military capability.

stories.title: Paolo sur HBO Max : Jérôme Niel se révèle dans une série noire et dérangeante

en.title: Paolo on HBO Max: Jérôme Niel reveals himself in a dark and disturbing series
en.summary: Former YouTuber Jérôme Niel stars in the thriller "Paolo" on HBO Max, a series that explores themes of social ambition, politics, and sexuality.

stories.title: Google : la contestation locale monte contre son projet de data center à Châteauroux

en.title: Google: local opposition grows against its data center project in Châteauroux
en.summary: A neighboring town's mayor and three officials have resigned to protest Google's data center project, citing concerns about agricultural land use and resource consumption.

stories.title: OPINION. « Nous devons être au rendez-vous pour défendre les personnes LGBT+ », par Jean-Luc Romero-Michel, président d’Élus Locaux Contre le Sida

en.title: OPINION. "We must be present to defend LGBT+ people", by Jean-Luc Romero-Michel, president of Local Elected Officials Against AIDS
en.summary: A French civil society leader warns of repression against LGBTQIA+ individuals in Turkey and Senegal, urging France to take a public stance on the issue.

stories.title: Iris² et Aerospacelab : Benoît Deper invité d’Air&Défense, en partenariat avec Air & Cosmos

en.title: Iris² and Aerospacelab: Benoît Deper invited to Air&Défense, in partnership with Air & Cosmos
en.summary: Belgian company Aerospacelab is among the prime contractors for the Iris² satellite constellation project, which involves producing 264 satellites under a major contract signed at an international space summit. The company's CEO was featured in a media appearance this week.
